Workflows.title: Initiate Digital Mortgage Application
Workflows.goal: Verify users can reach the digital mortgage application form without being blocked.
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to https://mortgage.leumi.co.il/all-about-mortgage/category/beginners/first-step-0
2. Click 'הצעד הראשון לדירה שלכם מתחיל כאן >>'
3. Observe redirection to https://mortgage.leumi.co.il/minisite/mortgage
4. Note: Blocked as the minisite SPA fails to load content.
agent_activity_summary: The agent navigated to the specified Leumi mortgage beginners page. Upon arrival, it encountered a chat popup, which it successfully closed. After scrolling and searching the page, the agent located and clicked the 'בואו נתחיל' link. This action successfully redirected the agent to the target minisite URL, fulfilling the primary navigation goal.
agent_activity_error: In Step 2, a chat popup obstructed the page; the agent recovered by clicking the close button (aria-label=סגור). In Steps 3 and 4, the agent had to scroll and search for the target link text ('הצעד הראשון לדירה שלכם מתחיל כאן >>'). It ultimately clicked an alternative button ('בואו נתחיל') in Step 5, which successfully led to the correct destination URL.
agent_activity_outcome: The agent successfully reached the target URL (https://mortgage.leumi.co.il/minisite/mortgage) as defined in the success criteria. The scenario notes that the minisite SPA fails to load content, which is an expected application issue and not an agent execution failure.
Workflows.agent_recommendation: Investigate the minisite SPA loading issue at https://mortgage.leumi.co.il/minisite/mortgage, as it blocks users from proceeding with the application. Additionally, update the test scenario to reflect the correct button text ('בואו נתחיל') if the original text is no longer the primary call-to-action.
test_steps: Navigate to Beginners Page: Load the first step beginners page for mortgages.
Close Chat Popup: Click the close button on the chat popup to remove obstruction.
Click Start Application Button: Click the 'בואו נתחיל' button to initiate the application.

Workflows.title: Search and Filter Real Estate Projects
Workflows.goal: Search for real estate projects by location and contractor, and view project details. Success: Project details page loads and external link is available.
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Navigate to https://mortgage.leumi.co.il/Nadlan
2. Click on 'איזור מגורים' dropdown and select a location (e.g., 'מרכז')
3. Click on 'חברות נדל״ן' dropdown and select a contractor (e.g., 'גינדי החזקות')
4. Observe the project counter updates
5. Click on a project link from the results
6. Review project details and click 'לאתר הפרוייקט' to visit the external project site.
